title: Most news apps are built to keep you scrolling, not to keep you informed.
body:
We have all felt the fatigue of the endless feed. You open an app to catch up on the world, but instead, you find yourself wading through clickbait, rage-bait, and stories that just do not matter to your life or your work.

True personalization is not about showing you more of what you already like. It is about filtering out the noise so you can actually understand what is happening. It is about respecting your time by giving you the signal without the static.

When we built Headlinne, we wanted to solve for clarity. We believe AI should act like an editor who knows your interests, not an algorithm trying to maximize your screen time. You should be able to get a briefing that is relevant, accurate, and concise, allowing you to get the information you need and get on with your day.

I am curious how you currently manage your information diet. Do you feel like you are in control of what you read, or are you just reacting to what the algorithm pushes to you?
cta: We are building a better way to stay informed at HEADLINNE.com.
